invalid_event_conservation.qualification: Every reason count and invalid_events must be zero; reason buckets diagnose a failed run and never waive it.

roi_contract.boundary_reentry: The first observed start PC and first subsequent end PC define the single ROI. Repeated start or end PC matches remain counted in start_hits/end_hits but do not open a second ROI and are not invalid events.
roi_contract.complete_intervals: Only intervals that start after the start boundary and terminate no later than the end edge enter duration histograms.
roi_contract.cycle_window: For start edge S and end edge E, sample the edge-old bridge image on S+1 through E, for E-S cycle samples.
roi_contract.left_censor: An interval active on S is marked left_censored and excluded from complete duration histograms.
roi_contract.right_censor: An eligible interval still active after the E sample is marked right_censored and excluded from complete duration histograms.
roi_contract.same_cycle: A lane0 start followed by a lane1 end on the same edge has zero full-cycle samples and is not a qualified timing region.
roi_contract.same_edge_stage: An A/D AW/W completion and B terminal observed on the same edge contributes a complete zero-cycle aw_w_to_b interval.
